name: Sandeshify Messaging Automation for WooCommerce
author: Santosh Gautam

sections.description:
Sandeshify Messaging Automation for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to the WhatsApp Business API so you can automatically notify customers about their orders via WhatsApp.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.

Features

  • Order Created Notification – Automatically send a WhatsApp message when a new order is placed.
  • Order Completed Notification – Notify customers when their order status changes to Completed.
  • Message Templates – Customise your messages with variables like {customer_name}, {order_id}, and {order_total}.
  • Test Mode / Live Mode – Test your setup without sending real messages.
  • Send Test Message – Verify your API connection with a single click.
  • Manual Send – Send a WhatsApp message directly from any WooCommerce order page.
  • Message Logs – Track all sent messages with Success / Failed / Test filters and pagination.
  • Encrypted Credentials – Your API credentials are AES-256 encrypted before being stored.
  • Duplicate Prevention – Prevents the same message from being sent twice within 5 minutes.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Meta WhatsApp Business API account

External Service

This plugin connects to the Meta (Facebook) WhatsApp Business Cloud API to send WhatsApp messages to customers.

  • Service: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API
  • Purpose: Sending WhatsApp notifications when WooCommerce order events occur.
  • Data sent: Customer phone number, order number, order total, customer name.
  • When: Only when a notification is triggered and enabled by the store admin in Live Mode.
  • Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • Meta Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/terms/
  • WhatsApp Business Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy/

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.

Developer

Built by Santosh Gautam.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Meta (Facebook) WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

  • Service URL: https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/
  • Purpose: Sending WhatsApp messages to customers when WooCommerce order events occur.
  • Data Sent: Customer phone number, order ID, order total, customer name.
  • When: Only when a notification event is triggered and enabled.
  • Conditions: Only in Live Mode. No data is sent in Test Mode.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.

  • Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • Meta Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/terms/
  • WhatsApp Business Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy/

Store owners are responsible for obtaining appropriate customer consent before sending WhatsApp messages.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce first.
  2. Upload the sandeshify-messaging-automation-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Sandeshify to configure.
  5. Enter your Meta WhatsApp Business API credentials.
  6. Enable notifications under the Notifications tab.
  7. Customise message templates under the Templates tab.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Which WhatsApp API does this use?

This plugin uses the official Meta (Facebook) WhatsApp Business Cloud API. You will need a Meta Developer account and a WhatsApp Business phone number. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp.

Are my API credentials safe?

Yes. Credentials are encrypted using AES-256-CBC before being stored in the WordPress database.

Can I send messages in Test Mode?

In Test Mode no real messages are sent. All attempts are logged as “Test” so you can verify your setup without consuming API quota.

Why am I getting a HTTP 400 error?

WhatsApp Business API only allows free-form text messages within a 24-hour conversation window. Outside this window, you must use pre-approved Meta message templates. This is a Meta API restriction.
